Title: King of Hell
Writer: Geoff Aull, Garth Ennis, Darick Robertson
Actors: Karl Urban, Jack Quaid, Antony Starr
Plot: The Boys head to Fort Hampton seeking V1, but tensions flare within the group. Homelander and Soldier Boy arrive with the same goal. Back at Vought, writers brainstorm ways to rebrand Homelander as a deity for public consumption.
